current_claim: A local estate-anatomy and evolution workbench combining live repository observations, explicit actors and authority, stress testing, decision circulation, migration, and succession.
mechanism: Machine observation and human-owned evaluation remain separate while organ anatomy, candidates, actors, evidence, stress, decision, migration, and succession are carried through one explicit record.

findings.title: Repository observation is live, but the complete decision loop is still proved mainly through a worked estate.
findings.mechanism: The collector can observe real heads, workflows, pull requests, tags, and failure states while anatomy, candidate selection, authority decision, migration, and verification remain predominantly embedded examples.
findings.acceptance: Carry one real organ from observation through anatomy, candidate comparison, stress, authority decision, migration, verification, and cold-successor replay with exact receipts.

findings.title: Actor-role overlap is modeled but not yet qualified through seat-specific operation.
findings.mechanism: The tool can display sponsor, validator, decider, maintainer, and beneficiary concentration without proving that each role receives different evidence, controls, refusal conditions, acceptance criteria, and handoff obligations.
findings.acceptance: Play the same organ from every functional seat and verify distinct lawful actions, information needs, refusals, and successor outputs.

findings.title: The live observation product lacks a retained visual, compact-width, and low-connectivity qualification package.
findings.mechanism: Static and browser tests can confirm object presence while typography, dense comparison tables, stale-source warnings, keyboard order, touch behavior, and offline replay remain under-evidenced.
findings.acceptance: Retain desktop and mobile goldens, keyboard and touch traces, stale and failed source captures, low-connectivity behavior, and a cold offline replay.

assets_required: observation source receipts and rights metadata
stale, missing, contradictory, and provider-loss fixtures
next_gate: Complete one real organ lifecycle from live observation to verified migration and successor reconstruction.
